target.statement: NeighborDiv AUC = 0.6166 on Cora (training-free, deterministic; also the Avg AUC 0.6465 across 7 datasets)
target.table_ref: Table 1 (SDIT AUC), Cora column; Avg column
target.dataset: Cora (plus YelpChi, Reddit, T-Finance, Tolokers, Disney, Questions for the Avg)

compute.basis: Method is a few dozen lines (truncated SVD r=8, l1/l2 normalize, sample <=k neighbor pairs, cosine-similarity variance, median+z-score); cost is dominated by downloading 7 public benchmark graphs and running SVD on Cora (2708x1433) and T-Finance (39k nodes), all CPU-feasible in minutes.
